Historical.name: Sigiriya Rock Fortress
Historical.description: An ancient palace and fortress complex carved into a massive column of rock.

Historical.name: Polonnaruwa Ancient City
Historical.description: The second most ancient of Sri Lanka's kingdoms, featuring well-preserved ruins and giant Buddha statues.

Historical.name: Galle Dutch Fort
Historical.description: A 16th-century fortified city built by the Portuguese and extensively fortified by the Dutch.

Historical.name: Anuradhapura Sacred City
Historical.description: The first ancient capital of Sri Lanka, famous for its ruins of ancient Lankan civilization.

Historical.name: Dambulla Cave Temple
Historical.description: The largest and best-preserved cave temple complex in Sri Lanka, packed with ancient statues and murals.

Historical.name: Yapahuwa Rock Fortress
Historical.description: A massive granite rock rising abruptly from the plain, serving as the capital in the 13th century.

Historical.name: Mihintale
Historical.description: A mountain peak believed to be the site of a meeting that inaugurated the presence of Buddhism in Sri Lanka.

Historical.name: Ritigala Forest Monastery
Historical.description: An ancient Buddhist monastery and mountain strict nature reserve shrouded in myth.

Historical.name: Fort Frederick
Historical.description: A fort built by the Portuguese completed in 1624 CE, built on Swami Rock.

Historical.name: Nalanda Gedige
Historical.description: An ancient complete stone building near Matale, known for its mix of Hindu and Buddhist architecture.

Beaches.name: Mirissa Beach
Beaches.description: A crescent-shaped beach famous for vibrant nightlife and whale watching.

Beaches.name: Unawatuna Beach
Beaches.description: A major tourist attraction known for its beautiful beach and corals.

Beaches.name: Arugam Bay
Beaches.description: A world-renowned surf spot located on the dry zone of Sri Lanka's southeast coast.

Beaches.name: Nilaveli Beach
Beaches.description: A pristine coastal resort town with white sands and calm waters, near Pigeon Island.

Beaches.name: Hiriketiya Beach
Beaches.description: A gorgeous horseshoe bay that has become a haven for surfers and digital nomads.

Beaches.name: Bentota Beach
Beaches.description: A premium beach destination known for water sports and luxury resorts.

Beaches.name: Pasikudah Beach
Beaches.description: Famous for its incredibly shallow and calm reef, allowing you to walk miles into the sea.

Beaches.name: Tangalle Beach
Beaches.description: Vast stretches of quiet, golden sandy beaches perfect for peaceful retreats.

Beaches.name: Hikkaduwa Beach
Beaches.description: Known for strong surf, coral sanctuary, and a very active beach party scene.

Beaches.name: Casuarina Beach
Beaches.description: Considered the best beach in the Jaffna Peninsula, named after the Casuarina trees lining it.

Adventure.name: Adam's Peak (Sri Pada)
Adventure.description: A 2,243m tall conical mountain famous for the 'sacred footprint' and a challenging night climb.

Adventure.name: Ella Rock
Adventure.description: A challenging hike through tea plantations and railways offering panoramic views of the hill country.

Adventure.name: Kitulgala White Water Rafting
Adventure.description: The adventure sports capital of Sri Lanka, offering thrilling rafting on the Kelani River.

Adventure.name: Knuckles Mountain Range
Adventure.description: A rugged mountain range offering some of the best and most isolated trekking paths in the country.

Adventure.name: Horton Plains & World's End
Adventure.description: A protected national park featuring a dramatic 4,000-foot sheer drop.

Adventure.name: Pidurangala Rock
Adventure.description: A massive rock formation offering a rugged climb and the best viewing angle of Sigiriya.

Adventure.name: Ambuluwawa Tower
Adventure.description: A unique, terrifyingly narrow winding tower situated on a mountain peak offering 360-degree views.

Adventure.name: The Pekoe Trail
Adventure.description: A newly established 300km walking trail navigating through Sri Lanka's scenic tea country.

Adventure.name: Meemure Village Trek
Adventure.description: An isolated village deep in the Knuckles range, perfect for hardcore jungle trekking and camping.

Adventure.name: Makandawa Forest Reserve
Adventure.description: A pristine rainforest perfect for bird watching, waterfall abseiling, and jungle hiking.

Urban.name: Lotus Tower
Urban.description: The tallest self-supported structure in South Asia, offering an observation deck and revolving restaurant.

Urban.name: Galle Face Green
Urban.description: A 5 hectare ocean-side urban park, perfect for street food and evening strolls.

Urban.name: Dutch Hospital Shopping Precinct
Urban.description: A heritage building transformed into a high-end dining and shopping complex.

Urban.name: Pettah Floating Market
Urban.description: An urban market featuring stalls situated on boats over the Beira Lake.

Urban.name: Independence Square
Urban.description: A national monument and a popular recreational area for jogging and relaxing.

Urban.name: Red Mosque (Jami Ul-Alfar)
Urban.description: A striking red-and-white candy-striped mosque located in the bustling Pettah district.

Urban.name: Colombo City Centre
Urban.description: A premier modern lifestyle mall overlooking the Beira Lake.

Urban.name: Viharamahadevi Park
Urban.description: The oldest and largest urban park in Colombo, featuring massive trees and a golden Buddha statue.

Urban.name: Kandy City Centre (KCC)
Urban.description: A modern commercial and shopping complex blending with traditional Kandyan architecture.

Urban.name: Jaffna Public Library
Urban.description: A beautifully restored historical building that stands as an iconic urban landmark in the north.

Religious.name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Religious.description: A world-renowned Buddhist temple housing the relic of the tooth of the Buddha.

Religious.name: Ruwanwelisaya
Religious.description: A massive hemispherical stupa considered a marvel of ancient architectural engineering.

Religious.name: Kelaniya Raja Maha Vihara
Religious.description: A revered Buddhist temple believed to have been visited by Buddha himself.

Religious.name: Gangaramaya Temple
Religious.description: One of the most important temples in Colombo, blending modern architecture and cultural essence.

Religious.name: Nallur Kandaswamy Kovil
Religious.description: A magnificent and highly venerated Hindu temple dedicated to Lord Murugan.

Religious.name: Kataragama Temple
Religious.description: A unique pilgrimage town sacred to Buddhists, Hindus, and indigenous Vedda people.

Religious.name: Koneswaram Temple
Religious.description: A classical-medieval Hindu temple complex perched high on Swami Rock overlooking the ocean.

Religious.name: Seetha Amman Temple
Religious.description: A vibrant Hindu temple marking the site where Sita was held captive in the Ramayana epic.

Religious.name: Munneswaram Temple
Religious.description: An important regional Hindu temple complex in existence since the epic of Ramayana.

Religious.name: Shrine of Our Lady of Madhu
Religious.description: A revered Roman Catholic Marian shrine with a history of over 400 years.

Other.name: Yala National Park
Other.description: Sri Lanka's most famous wildlife park, boasting a high density of leopards.

Other.name: Nine Arches Bridge
Other.description: A stunning colonial-era railway bridge built entirely of brick, rock, and cement without steel.

Other.name: Sinharaja Forest Reserve
Other.description: A national park and biodiversity hotspot recognized as a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

Other.name: Udawalawe National Park
Other.description: One of the best places in the world to see wild elephants roaming freely.

Other.name: Peradeniya Royal Botanical Gardens
Other.description: Renowned for its collection of orchids and over 4000 species of plants.

Other.name: Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage
Other.description: A nursery and captive breeding ground for wild Asian elephants.

Other.name: Minneriya National Park
Other.description: Famous for the 'Elephant Gathering', the largest known meeting place of Asian elephants.

Other.name: Diyaluma Falls
Other.description: The second-highest waterfall in Sri Lanka, featuring natural infinity pools at the top.

Other.name: Little Adam's Peak
Other.description: An easily accessible mountain peak in Ella offering spectacular views of the gorge.

Other.name: Madu River Safari
Other.description: A complex coastal wetland ecosystem perfect for boat safaris through mangrove tunnels.
